create_composite_observer: create a CompositeObserver to dispatch values to multiple child observers by key
create_epoch_end_observer: create an EpochEndObserver to call a callback function when an epoch ends
create_value_list_observer: create a ValueListObserver to collect observed values into a list and reset them
create_tensorboard_scalar_observer: create a TensorBoardScalarObserver to log scalar values to TensorBoard via SummaryWriterContext
create_interval_aggregating_observer: create an IntervalAggregatingObserver to aggregate values at fixed intervals and flush on epoch end
